about.title: About Me
bio: A Full-Stack Developer based in Iran, passionate about building intuitive, human-centered digital experiences. With expertise in modern web technologies and mobile development, I bring ideas to life through clean code and thoughtful design.

My journey into development began with a curiosity for how things work on the web. That led me to embrace full-stack development as both a craft and a mindset, one that balances performance, usability, and maintainability.
Currently working on exciting projects and always looking for opportunities to collaborate on interesting projects and build amazing applications. Dreams come true one day! 🚀
